d: Gold prices in India have fallen nearly 20% from their January record highs, but some of the country’s biggest jewellers are holding back on fresh purchases ahead of Diwali and Dhanteras. In this video, Firstpost examines why international gold prices have dropped, with a stronger US dollar, rising bond yields, interest rate expectations and profit-taking adding to the pressure.
